KedouImageLoader.description: Pick images on the node panel (multi-select, upload supported); each image gets its own IMAGE output slot. Unused slots emit None, so downstream multi-image nodes ignore that route. Select outputs only the picked photos in click order; Batch queues the photos through the workflow one by one.

media_state.name: media_state
media_state.tooltip: JSON describing the photos currently on the panel. Hidden by the node UI; do not wire or edit it by hand.

KedouPromptBox.description: Prompt input box with a built-in phrase library: type on the node, append entries from the library dropdown, pin/recall recent prompts and save the current text as a preset. Connect prompt to the positive conditioning input of a text encoder.

prompt_state.name: prompt_state
prompt_state.tooltip: The prompt text; passed straight through to the prompt output.

usage.name: usage
usage.tooltip: Which kind of job this prompt is for; only filters the phrase library, it does not affect the output.
